messages.body:

restraint_wt=25, // Cartesian restraint

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
The restraintmask etc go inside the cntrl namelist, not in a group input.
Read the output file above the energies, it will tell you if it reads your
restraints.

messages.author: Adrian Roitberg
messages.body:

ntmin=1, ncyc= 10000,
ntpr=5,
ntr=1,
restraint_wt=25, // Cartesian restraint
restraintmask=':1-492',
